exposure: visual analog scale for abdominal pain ≥4
removal of scar, excision of mass, and exploration underneath the scar
outcome: Postoperative recurrence of cesarean scar endometriosis
cohort: 272 women who underwent open lesion resection for cesarean scar endometriosis
finding: Higher visual analog scale for abdominal pain (≥4) and local excision of mass were identified as risk factors for postoperative recurrence, while integrated excision (removal of scar, excision of mass, and exploration underneath the scar) was found to be protective.
mod_finding: The surgical method of integrated excision (removal of scar, excision of mass, and exploration underneath the scar) was identified as a protective factor against recurrence of Cesarean scar endometriosis, while local excision of mass was associated with higher risk of recurrence.
